verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only shows SvelteKit's adapter-static for static site generation (svelte-docs-16) and generic framework comparisons to Next.js/Nuxt (svelte-docs-18), but contains no mention of adapter-vercel, adapter-netlify, adapter-cloudflare, or any serverless/edge deployment adapters that would let a server-rendered SvelteKit app deploy to serverless/edge runtimes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or community evidence of serverless/edge adapters, zero-config deployment targets, or hands-on reports of deploying SSR apps to platforms like Vercel/Cloudflare Workers.
